caption.body:
18 websites every exporter should bookmark.

Good exporters do not guess. They check official sources and real trade data. In this post: government portals like DGFT and ICEGATE, export promotion bodies such as FIEO, APEDA, MPEDA, the Spices Board and the Coir Board, finance bodies like ECGC, EXIM Bank and SIDBI, and trade data tools like ITC Trade Map, UN Comtrade, WTO and the World Bank WITS.

Save this post, open each site once, and keep the list handy when you research a new product or market.
